theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ C : NNReal, ∀ μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P), IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure μ' → ∃ a : Euclid P, (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 / 4 → μ {x | infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} < r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 2)) * μ univ ∧ μ' {x | infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} < r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 2)) * μ' univ
